research.primaryRule: Underdog between +3.5 and +7 with at least 2 of 3 advantages (rest/schedule, non-explosive down-to-down efficiency, QB passing efficiency/YPA) plus a verified live moneyline better than the frozen fair-ML estimate.
research.spreadEdgeRole: Spread-model edge is a confidence/context input, not a hard qualification gate. A weak or negative spread edge can reduce confidence, but it does not automatically veto a 2-of-3 profile with verified positive ML value.
research.historicalStatus: exploratory discovery sample; not independently validated with actual historical sportsbook moneylines
secondaryRules: ML Watchlist may include +3.5-to-+7 dogs with meaningful model/price interest that do not clear the full 2-of-3 profile.
+7.5 to +14 dogs remain excluded from the primary Special algorithm because the historical signal was unstable across 2024 and 2025.
Transfer-QB and other matchup traits may be displayed as context but do not alter the three core qualifier flags.
A verified sportsbook moneyline is mandatory for actionability; synthetic or estimated market ML prices are never executable.
Profile v1.1 begins prospective evaluation from adoption. Do not retroactively book wagers after kickoff or rewrite v1.0 results.
research.parlayNote: Only independently qualifying, live-priced individual Specials may be combined. Parlays remain experimental/high variance and are never forced.
research.versioningRule: v1.0 remains preserved as the original rule. v1.1 removes the hard spread-edge veto and uses verified ML-versus-fair value as the price gate after the 2-of-3 football profile qualifies. Future rule changes require a new version.

pricing.executionRule: After the 2-of-3 profile qualifies, a verified live moneyline must be better than the model fair ML to qualify as a Special. Estimated/synthetic prices cannot be stored as executable market prices.
pricing.lineShopping: Show a consistent primary/consensus price and optional best-available price; do not hindsight-select a bookmaker.

rest.reason: Both teams were opening the season; Hawaii also traveled to the mainland, so there was no rest/schedule advantage.

nonExplosive.reason: Hawaii held the stronger down-to-down/early-down profile in the 2025 head-to-head and entered against a Stanford defense that finished 2025 near the bottom nationally in pass defense; the advantage was efficiency-based rather than dependent on isolated explosives.

qbYpa.reason: Micah Alejado returned after a highly efficient 2025 and held the stronger cited EPA/dropback profile than Davis Warren's last healthy season.

reasons: Cleared 2 of 3 football-profile qualifiers: down-to-down efficiency and QB passing efficiency/YPA.
Verified +160 ML was materially better than the model fair ML of approximately +131 (about +4.8 percentage points of win-probability value).
risks: Spread edge was only about 1 point, so confidence was lower than a Special that also had a strong spread-model disagreement.
Pofele Ashlock was out, reducing Hawaii receiving certainty.
v1.1 was adopted at/after the scheduled Week 0 kickoff, so this game was not entered retroactively into the official prospective betting ledger.
candidates.note: Hawaii was the motivating v1.1 example, but it is recorded only as a completed no-entry profile because the rule change occurred at/after kickoff. Stanford won 37-27; no units or official ML result are booked.

candidates.moneylineSource: DraftKings via Action Network live board

rest.reason: Both teams were opening the season and Memphis traveled to Las Vegas; no rest/schedule edge was established.

nonExplosive.reason: Pregame matchup analysis identified Memphis' front seven as the unit most capable of winning down-to-down against UNLV's run-first offense and limiting its most repeatable offensive path.

qbYpa.reason: Marcus Stokes' strong Division II production was not a sufficiently comparable FBS YPA/efficiency sample to award the frozen QB advantage over experienced Jackson Arnold.

reasons: Verified +164 pregame ML was better than the roughly +149 fair ML, but the football profile cleared only 1 of 3 qualifiers.
risks: Did not satisfy the primary 2-of-3 profile requirement.
The spread remained only about 1 point better than the model fair spread.
candidates.note: Memphis remained Watchlist-only through kickoff and never became an Underdog Special. Memphis won 27-21, but the outcome does not change or retroactively relax the 2-of-3 profile rule; no units are booked.

migration.reason: A hard spread-edge gate could reject a dog that independently clears the football profile and has verified positive moneyline value. v1.1 makes verified ML-versus-fair value the price gate and retains spread disagreement as confidence/context.
migration.week0Handling: No retroactive official wager or ledger entry was created for Hawaii because the rule was adopted at/after scheduled kickoff.
